evidence_is_sampled: This is dense sampling, not a proof of non-interference over the continuum. Reported as such.
method: Rigid transforms of as-built solids. At every sample all body pairs are measured with BRepAlgoAPI_Common (volume) and BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape (distance). Overlap is the volume, never inferred from distance.
